fields.statement: At ad06447d3 (detached checkout) I checked the acceptance's conditions directly, since the agent-docs-consistent test is a later leaf not yet built: agents/README.md exists; AGENTS.md links [agents/README.md](agents/README.md) on line 6, right under its intro, as where role instructions live; agents/ holds no *.md other than README.md, so the index (which states the one-line form '- [name.md](name.md): <which agent> reads it <when>' for future docs) is complete; README.md's ../AGENTS.md link resolves. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestClaudeMD|TestAgents|TestMakeUpdate' passes (TestClaudeMDScopedTests, TestClaudeMDImportsAgentsMD, TestClaudeMDCommandsNameMakeUpdate, TestMakeUpdateDryRun). make self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor files and index.md, which run close-out's rhiza render writes; no fold or model errors.
